## By Aphelenchus

```{r}

aphelenchus = population %>% 
  filter(quantity >0) %>% 
  filter(genus == "Aphelenchus") %>% 
  #filter(!soil %in% c("Neossolo","Chernossolo","Gleissolo")) %>% 
  filter(soil_corrigido %in% c("2","5","6")) %>% 
  filter(region %in% c("South","Southwest","Center","East")) %>% 
    group_by(samples,region,city) %>% 
  summarise(
    quantity = sum(quantity)
  )


aphelenchus_glmer = glmmTMB(quantity ~ (1|region:city) +  (1|region:city:samples), data = aphelenchus,
                    family = poisson(link = "log"))


summary(aphelenchus_glmer)
check_singularity(aphelenchus_glmer)
check_overdispersion(aphelenchus_glmer)
model_performance(aphelenchus_glmer)
check_model(aphelenchus_glmer)

#ggsave("model_check/check_aphelenchus_abundance_glmm.png", bg = "white", dpi = 600, width = 12)



aphelenchus_res <- simulateResiduals(aphelenchus_glmer)
plot(aphelenchus_res)



```
